devaputta.g: Kassapasammāsambuddhakāle kiresa Candano nāma upāsako aḍḍho mahaddhano tīṇi ratanāni catūhi paccayehi pūjetvā devaloke nibbatto, purimanāmena Candano devaputtotveva saṅkhaṁ gato.
ayaṁ kira Kolanagare Mahāmoggallānattherassa upaṭṭhākaputto daharakāleyeva therassa santike vasanto jhānaṁ nibbattetvā kālaṅkato brahmaloke uppajji.
nidāne nigame ca āgataṁ, tattha devaputtena satthu vuttappakāraguṇapavedanavasena vuttaṁ.

devaputto.g: Kassapasammāsambuddhakāle kiresa Candano nāma upāsako aḍḍho mahaddhano tīṇi ratanāni catūhi paccayehi pūjetvā devaloke nibbatto, purimanāmena Candano devaputtotveva saṅkhaṁ gato.
ayaṁ kira Kolanagare Mahāmoggallānattherassa upaṭṭhākaputto daharakāleyeva therassa santike vasanto jhānaṁ nibbattetvā kālaṅkato brahmaloke uppajji.
nidāne nigame ca āgataṁ, tattha devaputtena satthu vuttappakāraguṇapavedanavasena vuttaṁ.

Tattha dibbanti kīḷanti pañcahi dibbehi kāmaguṇehīti devā, devānaṁ putto, devo eva vā putto devaputto, ahaṁ devaputto santo vijjamāno dibbaṁ kakkārupupphaṁ paggayha pakārena gahetvā Sikhissa Bhagavato abhiropayiṁ pūjesinti attho.

Devaputte.g: kassaci pārijuññassa abhāvadīpanato “saddhāyā”ti-ādinā vuttassa pabbajitabhāvassa pākaṭīkaraṇaṁ.

devāpī.g: “Pañcime gahapatayo ānisaṁsā”ti-ādīsu1 ānisaṁsasaddo phalapariyāyopi hotīti āha “

devāpi.g: “Pañcime gahapatayo ānisaṁsā”ti-ādīsu1 ānisaṁsasaddo phalapariyāyopi hotīti āha “

Devaputto.g: kāmaṁ tasseva visesādhigamo idhāgato, pañcasatamattāhi pana accharāhi saddhiṁ sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhahīti veditabbaṁ.
Pañcālacaṇḍo viya Hatthakamahābrahmā viya Sanaṅkumārabrahmā viya ca eko Dhammakathikadevaputto.

devapadānī.g: devānaṁ ñāṇena, devassa1 vā ñāṇena akkantapadāni.

devapadāni.g: devānaṁ ñāṇena, devassa1 vā ñāṇena akkantapadāni.

devappatta.g: upapattidevanibbattakaṁ dibbavihāraṁ dibbavihārena ca arahattaṁ pattā.

devappatto.l: Evaṁ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu devappatto hotī
devappatto.g: evaṁ rūpāvacaracatutthajjhāne ṭhatvā cittaṁ vivaṭṭetva arahattaṁ patto devappatto nāma hoti, catūsu brahmavihāresu ṭhatvā cittaṁ vivaṭṭetvā arahattaṁ patto brahmappatto nāma, catūsu arūpajjhānesu ṭhatvā cittaṁ vivaṭṭetvā arahattaṁ patto āneyyañjappatto nāma.

Devaputta.g: Pañcālacaṇḍo viya Hatthakamahābrahmā viya Sanaṅkumārabrahmā viya ca eko Dhammakathikadevaputto.

Devāpi.g: dukkhappattā subrahmadevaputtādayo sukhappattā ca sabbeva dasasahassacakkavāḷavāsino devāpi tumhe namassanti.
devatāpi paṇḍitamanussāpi taṁ bhikkhuṁ upaṭṭhāya1 thomenti pasaṁsanti.
aññadatthu devā sakkādayo guṇavisesavidū, apisaddena manussāpi khattiyapaṇḍitādayo pasaṁsanti.
tādisassa bhusaṁ abhiviya santakāyavacīmanokammatāya upasantassa paramena satinepakkena samannāgamato sabbakālaṁ satimato piṇḍapātikassa bhikkhussa sakkādayo devāpi pihayanti patthenti.
visuddhidevā upapattidevā ca tathā vidū vidanti jānanti, tasmā sayaṁ tādisā devā ca pamāṇaṁ suddhāsuddhānaṁ suddhāsuddhabhāvajānane, na ye keci icchādosaparetā sattāti adhippāyo.
na kevalaṁ manussā eva, atha kho aparimāṇāsu lokadhātūsu devāpi taṁ namassanti.

Devāpī.g: devatāpi paṇḍitamanussāpi taṁ bhikkhuṁ upaṭṭhāya1 thomenti pasaṁsanti.

Devaparisā.g: Sakko devarājā vijayuttarasaṅkhaṁ gahetvā devaparisāya saddhiṁ abhisiñci.
